titulo_es: Marking an area of specialty with

かけては.es: en cuanto a; cuando se trata de
かけては.en: as regards; when it comes to

bloques.titulo: In this area, someone is particularly skilled or competent.
texto: It does not mean that this person is superior in all areas. The previous noun delimits the comparison.
In the case of the organization of old photographs, Tanaka is the one with the most experience.
In negotiating capacity, no one exceeds it.

frases.ja: 古い 写真 の 整理 に かけては、田中 さん が 一番 経験 を 持って います。
frases.es: En cuanto a organizar fotografías antiguas, Tanaka es quien tiene más experiencia.
frases.en: As for organizing old photographs, Tanaka is the one with the most experience.

frases.ja: 交渉 力 に かけては、彼女 の 右 に 出る 人 は いない。
frases.es: En capacidad de negociación, nadie la supera.
frases.en: In the ability to negotiate, no one overcomes it.
